attachment-transfer-limits-description: Dzudzanya mikano mihulwane ya saizi ya faela ya u layisha na u download. U hwalela ha API hu na mikano ya tsireledzo yo fhambanaho kha seva.
attachment-transfer-limits-invalid-value: Ni humbelwa u dzhenisa mukano wo teaho wa positive
attachment-transfer-limits-saved: Mikano ya u hwalela zwo namaṱheliswaho yo vhulungwa.
attachment-transfer-limits-title: Mikano ya Saizi ya Faela ya Zwo Namaṱheliswaho na API
attachment-upload-limit-label: Saizi khulwanesa ya faela ya u layisha zwo namaṱheliswaho
automatic-linked-url-schemes: Zwikimu zwa URL zwo dzudzanywaho zwi fanela u kiḽikea nga zwoṱhe. Tshikimu tshithihi tsha URL kha mutaladzi muṅwe na muṅwe
board-creation-admin-only: Vhalanguli fhedzi vha nga sika mabodo
board-view-aging-wip: Makhadi a khou hulwa kha mushumo (Aging WIP)
board-view-multiboard-cal: Khalenda ya bodo nnzhi dza Kanban
board-view-size-cycle-time: Saizi ya mushumo na tshifhinga tsha tshiimo
confirm-move-list-to-swimlane: Pfukisela mutevhe uyu na makhaḓi awo oṱhe kha iṅwe swimlane?
default-on-private-board: Zwo ḓoweleaho kha bodo ya tshiphiri
default-on-public-board: Zwo ḓoweleaho kha bodo ya tshitshavha
delete-board-confirm-popup: Mitevhe yoṱhe, makhadi, dziḽeibuḽu na nyito zwi ḓo suswa, nahone a ni tsha ḓo kona u vhuyedzedza data ya bodo ya Kanban. A zwi koni u humiselwa murahu.
drag-to-reorder: Kokodzani u dzudzanya hafhu. Khii dza misevhe ya nṱha na fhasi dzi sudzulusa nga vhukando vhuthihi.
enable-permanent-delete: Tendelani u thutha lwa tshoṱhe kha Mulanguli Muhulwane
enable-permanent-delete-description: Tendelani Vhalanguli Vhahulwane u thutha lwa tshoṱhe zwi re ngomu zwo thuthwaho nga nḓila i humulelaho. U tendela nzudzanyo iyi a zwi thuthi tshithu nga zwoṱhe.
external-link-identifier-aliases: Khonḓiso dza {identifier}, sa tsumbo TK=Task, IN=Incident
feature-approval-required: Itani uri zwiitwa zwo engedzwaho nga khwiniso dza WeKan zwi si shume u swika mulanguli a tshi zwi tendela
feature-board-summary-desc: Menyu ya bodo → Manweledzo i sumbedza zwe muthu muṅwe na muṅwe a zwi ita kha bodo nga ḓuvha kana vhege ya u fhedza, na zwo fhiriwaho nga tshifhinga.
feature-pilot-users: Vhashumisi vha u linga vhane vha dovha vha vhona zwiitwa zwo dzimiwaho
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Madzina a vhashumisi, o khethekanywaho nga khoma
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Zwo vhulungwa. Madzina aya a vhashumisi ha ngo wanala:
feature-preview-admins: Vhalanguli vha vhona zwiitwa zwo dzimiwaho uri vha zwi linge u thoma
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menyu ya bodo → Milayo i themendela milayo u bva kha zwine vhathu vha zwi ita nga tshanḓa tshifhinga tshoṱhe.
feature-search-phrases-desc: U ṱoḓa hoṱhe hu pfesesa mitaladzo i ngaho "dzikarata dzanga dzo fhiriwaho nga tshifhinga".
feature-since-last-visit: U bva musi ni tshi dalela lwa u fhedza
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menyu ya bodo → U bva musi ni tshi dalela lwa u fhedza i sumbedza zwe vhaṅwe vha zwi shandukisa kha bodo.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Khaḽenda na khaḽenda ya bodo nnzhi.
feature-views-chat-desc: Bodo sa fhethu ha mushumo ha nyambedzano: fhethu ha mushumo, dzibodo, nḓila, mitevhe na garaṱa sa muri wa zwiteshi, garaṱa vhukati na mihumbulo yayo sa milaedza ya nyambedzano.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Garaṱa dzi fanaho kha zwigwada zwinzhi zwa kholomu zwi re na madzina - nga u fhedza, ndeme, tshiga kana tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe - dzi tshi tshimbidzwa vhukati ha kholomu nga u kokodza.
feature-views-email-desc: Bodo sa bogisi ḽa poswo: mutevhe wa imeili ndi Bogisi ḽa zwi dzhenaho, mitevhe ndi dzifola, zwiswayo ndi zwiswayo, nahone miraḓo i ṅwala na u fhindula imeili i tshi bva kha ḓiresi ya bodo.
feature-views-flow-charts: Tshati dza u elela ha mishumo
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Mishumo yo salaho, mishumo yo fhelaho, u elela ho kuvhanganywaho, tshifhinga tsha u shuma na tsha u lindela, tshivhalo tsha mishumo yo fhelaho, tshifhinga tshe mishumo ya lindela, zwikhukhulisi, Monte Carlo na zwiṅwe zwipimo zwa u elela ha mishumo.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Nḓila tharu dza u vhona tshati dza Gantt.
feature-views-map-desc: Magaraṱa sa zwiga kha tshifanyiso tsho dzheniswaho.
feature-views-overview-desc: Mbalombalo, u kuvhanganya nga muthu o ṋewaho mushumo, pulane ya mushumo, deshibodo na bodo khulwane.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Mishumo ya tshibveledzwa yo salaho, zwifhinga zwipfufhi zwa u shuma, muvhigo wa tshifhinga tshenetsho na luvhilo lwa mushumo.
feature-views-table-desc: Bodo sa thebuḽu ya magaraṱa ane a nga tevhekanywa.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Bodo sa tshitevheli tsha thaidzo dza GitHub kana Gitea: garaṱa sa thaidzo, dziḽeibuḽu na zwiṱaraṱa, mahumbulwa sa nyambedzano, zwiṱumetshedzwa sa faela, na ḓivhazwakale ya bodo na u vhuisela murahu.
filter-no-due-date: A hu na ḓuvha ḽa u fhedza
home-board-badge: Bodo ḽa Hayani (ḽi vulwaho nga murahu ha u dzhena)
home-board-empty: Kokodzani bodo nthihi ya Kanban afha u i vula musi no dzhena
home-board-remove-confirm: Bvisani bodo iyi ya Kanban kha Hayani? Bodo yone a i suswi.
multi-selection-active: Kiḽikani zwibogisi zwa u swaya u nanga bodo dza Kanban
normal-assigned-only: Wa nga misi kha o avhelwaho fhedzi
select-only-one-board: Ni khou humbelwa uri ni nange bodo nthihi fhedzi
set-selected-home: Vhea sa bodo ḽa Hayani (ḽi vulwaho nga murahu ha u dzhena)
set-selected-starred: Isa naledzi kha mabodo o nangiwaho
set-selected-unstarred: Bvisa ṋaledzi kha bodo dza Kanban dzo nangwaho
show-desktop-drag-handles: Sumbedzani zwifaro zwa u kokodza kha dekhisithopo
unset-selected-home: Bvisani bodo ya Hayani yo nangiwaho
